# Google Cloud WAF: sustainability pillar reviews

Curated by Skill Harbor — @google's official Well-Architected Framework skill for the Sustainability pillar: principles and recommendations to shrink the environmental footprint of Google Cloud workloads — the shared-responsibility model, selecting low-carbon regions (CFE%), reducing AI/ML energy waste (matching algorithms to TPUs, model compression), rightsizing resources and scaling to zero, energy-efficient software design, storage lifecycle management against "dark data", continuous measurement with Carbon Footprint data in BigQuery, and a culture of sustainability — with workload assessment questions and a pass/fail validation checklist per theme. Honest caveats: this covers the sustainability pillar only — cost optimization, performance, and reliability have their own sibling skills (the file says not to use it for those); Apache-2.0 licensed.
